parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The backup schedule ID. You can call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to query the ID of the backup schedule.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs disable-backup-log --backup-plan-id dbstooi010000 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCziJZNwH0000 --disable-mysql-physical-backup-binlog-only false --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
